Miss. Anusha Sangami representing Shri.S. K. Kayakamath, learned counsel for the appellant submits that despite best efforts appellant could not trace the address of the first respondent and therefore, they are unable to take steps to NC: 2024:KHC-D:786 serve the notice of the appeal to the first respondent who is the claimant.

2. She further submits that the liability is challenged based on the ground that there is no proper endorsement and therefore, the case is now covered under the legal principles enunciated in Shriram General Insourance Co.
